description: 日本の法令の条・項・号の本文を読む。引用や説明の前に確かめる（改正で文言が変わっていることがある）。 Read the text of an article, paragraph or item of a Japanese law, to quote or explain it: the wording may have changed since a model learned it. One article, paragraph or item of a law, with everything under it. Call it with law and address: {"law": "labor-standards-act", "address": "art-36"}, or {"law": "労働基準法", "address": "第三十二条の三第一項"}. For each paragraph and item, the Japanese text (textJa), its English (textEn) and whose that English is (englishWhose: ministry — the Ministry of Justice's translation; corrected — the Ministry's with a slip this site corrected; machine — this site's machine translation, not official), and its url. Also the terms it defines, how many provisions it cites and how many cite it (references "lists" names them), and the official e-Gov page. A very long one — a big appended table, a 附則 of many articles — stops at a provision; continued.cursor, passed back as cursor with the same address, goes on from there. Shown to the reader as a card where the chat app can draw one. The text in force by default; asOf (a day) or version reads another text held — as it stood on a past day, or as an amendment not yet in force will leave it — and version says which text the answer is. Quoting it, link its url (the reader's page, with the English marked), not e-Gov's, and say whose English each quoted paragraph is.

address.description: The provision, as the statute writes it (第三十六条第二項第一号), as the Ministry's English does (Article 36(2)(i)), or as japanlaw.org does (art-36/par-2/item-1). A bare number is an article: 36. Supplementary provisions and appended tables use the site's addresses, which search and get_law hand out.

asOf.description: Read the text as it stood on this day, YYYY-MM-DD (2027-04-01): past, today or to come. Unset reads the text in force. A day whose text japanlaw.org does not hold is refused as not held, with the texts that are; never answered with the nearest text.

cursor.description: Go on from here: the cursor an earlier answer's continued gave, with the same address. Unset starts at the address.

lang.description: The language of the pages every url opens, and of the card get_provision is drawn as: "en" (default) or "ja". The text returned always holds both languages.

law.description: The law: its Japanese title (労働基準法), English title (Labor Standards Act), short name (労基法), slug (labor-standards-act) or e-Gov law ID (322AC0000000049).

references.description: "counts" (default): how many provisions this one cites and how many cite it. "lists": each of them too, with its url — the first 20 that cite it; get_citing_provisions has them all.

version.description: Read one held text by its version, as get_law's versions lists it (20270401_508AC0000000060). Unset reads the text in force. Pass asOf or version, not both.

name: get_provision
title: Read one provision
